admission.justification: Token ceilings live in wire_budget.py while instruction renewal checks them in scripts/instruction_renewal/budgets.py and tests enforce both; guarded by test_role_wire_token_budgets.py and budget suites.

applicability: mcp/src/agents_remember/application/role_capsules/wire_budget.py and scripts/instruction_renewal/budgets.py across all 8 default launch pairs and all 34 compiled capsule matrix keys.
conditions: WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS enforces final non-ratcheting o200k_base ceilings (2,500 / 3,000 / 3,800 tokens) across all 8 default launch pairs including heldOpeningPrompt prefixes, with Phase 1 appendix allowances removed.
COMPILED_CAPSULE_TOKEN_CEILINGS enforces final o200k_base ceilings (1,500 / 2,000 / 2,600 / 1,500 tokens) across all 34 compiled capsule matrix keys.
Siloed word-ceiling enforcement is retired from instruction renewal and budget tests while frozen D681/D682/D694 snapshots and new_source_budgets remain intact.
exclusions: Frozen historical registries (capsule-budgets.json, capsule-budgets-d694.json) and informational word counts in derived.current_measurements.
statement: wire_budget.py enforces final non-ratcheting WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS (2,500t / 3,000t / 3,800t across all 8 default launch pairs, including heldOpeningPrompt prefixes, with Phase 1 appendix allowances removed) and 34-key COMPILED_CAPSULE_TOKEN_CEILINGS (1,500 / 2,000 / 2,600 / 1,500), while siloed word-ceiling enforcement is retired from instruction renewal and budget tests without altering frozen D681/D682/D694 snapshots or new_source_budgets.
title: Final wire and 34-key compiled capsule token ceilings retire word ceilings
